tasks.title: Colonial North American Cooking in the Seventeenth Century
paras: In seventeenth-century colonial North America, all day-to-day cooking was done in the fireplace. Generally large, fireplaces were planned for cooking as well as for warmth. Those in the Northeast were usually four or five feet high, and in the South, they were often high enough for a person to walk into. A heavy timber called the mantel tree was used as a lintel to support the stonework above the fireplace opening.

Two ledges were built across from each other on the inside of the chimney. On these rested the ends of a "lug pole" from which pots were suspended when cooking. Wood from a freshly cut tree was used for the lug pole, so it would resist heat, but it had to be replaced frequently because it dried out and charred, and was thus weakened. When iron became easier to obtain, it was used instead of wood for lug poles, and later fireplaces had pivoting metal rods to hang pots from.

Beside the fireplace and built as part of it was the oven. It was made like a small, secondary fireplace with a flue leading into the main chimney to draw out smoke. On baking days (usually once or twice a week) a roaring fire of "oven wood," consisting of brown maple sticks, was maintained in the oven until its walls were extremely hot.

questions.stem: What is the main idea of the passage?

options.A: Cooking in colonial North America relied heavily on fireplaces and simple tools.
options.B: Colonial homes were primarily designed to accommodate large cooking areas.
options.C: The choice of materials for kitchen tools was based mainly on availability.
options.D: Baking was the most common cooking method in colonial kitchens.

questions.analysis: 题型：主旨题 正确答案：A. Cooking in colonial North America relied heavily on fireplaces and simple tools. 原文定位：第一段开头即指出“all day-to-day cooking was done in the fireplace”，接着详细描述fireplace结构与烹饪用具。 正确答案分析：全文围绕殖民地时期厨房的基本设施和使用方式展开，强调fireplace的重要性和当时的简易工具。 选项分析： B 夸大了房屋设计的目的，原文中房屋设计本身不是讨论重点。 C 材料选择有被提及，但不是主旨。 D 烘焙只是提到的一种做饭方式，非最常见方式。

questions.stem: According to the passage, how was food usually cooked in a pot in the seventeenth century?

options.A: By placing the pot directly into the fire
options.B: By putting the pot in the oven
options.C: By filling the pot with hot water
options.D: By hanging the pot on a pole over the fire

questions.analysis: 题型：细节题 正确答案：D. By hanging the pot on a pole over the fire 原文定位：第二段提到“from which pots were suspended when cooking”，即锅是悬挂在木杆上的。 正确答案分析：锅通过悬挂在横杆（lug pole）上来进行加热。 选项分析： A 锅放进火里未被提及。 B 烤箱是用于烘焙，不是日常用锅。 C 没有提到通过加水加热。 D 正确，对应“suspended when cooking”。

questions.stem: The word "obtain" in the passage is closest in meaning to
questions.analysis: 题型：词汇题 正确答案：D. acquire 原文定位：“When iron became easier to obtain...” 正确答案分析：“obtain”指“获得”，在此语境中指的是铁变得更容易“得到”。 选项分析： A. maintain（维持）——不符合上下文意思。 B. reinforce（加强）——与获得无关。 C. manufacture（制造）——指“生产”，与“获得”不完全等价。 D. acquire（获得）——最贴近语境含义。

questions.stem: Which of the following is mentioned as a disadvantage of using a wooden lug pole?

options.A: It was made of wood not readily available.
options.B: It was difficult to move or rotate.
options.D: It became too hot to touch.

questions.analysis: 题型：细节题 正确答案：C. It occasionally broke. 原文定位：“...had to be replaced frequently because it dried out and charred, and was thus weakened.” 正确答案分析：木杆由于烘烤变脆，会变弱，因此常常需要更换，意味着容易损坏或断裂。 选项分析： A 未提到木材难找。 B 未说木杆难以移动或旋转。 C 正确，文中说明因脆弱必须更换，暗示会断裂。 D 没有提到是否烫手。

questions.stem: What can be inferred about "oven wood" in comparison to other types of firewood?

options.A: It generated less smoke, making it more suitable for indoor use during baking.
options.B: It was capable of producing higher temperatures, which were necessary for oven heating.
options.C: It left behind fewer embers, allowing for a cleaner baking environment after removal.
options.D: It burned with a smaller flame, providing more controlled and even heat distribution.

questions.analysis: 题型：推理题 正确答案：B. It was capable of producing higher temperatures, which were necessary for oven heating. 原文定位：“a roaring fire of ‘oven wood’...until its walls were extremely hot.” 正确答案分析：使用oven wood的目的是将烤箱壁加热至极高温度，说明它燃烧时产生的热量比普通木材更强。 选项分析： A 没提到烟少。 B 正确，对应文中“extremely hot”。 C 没有提及灰烬量。 D 火焰控制或均匀性未被提及。
